long_biography.plain_text:
Healthcare-property investment specialist IMMAC grew out of a failed nursing-home deal that cost Marcus Schiermann his equity and left him with debt. Rather than abandon the sector, he examined operators, property economics and care quality, then formed a small team to structure long-term property funds. He later bought out his co-founder and expanded the platform into Austria, Britain and Ireland.

Schiermann sold a majority of IMMAC to a banking consortium in 2023, transferring operational leadership while Profunda retained a minority interest. His work after the sale included passing on the market knowledge used to assess care-home operators and tenants. At Profunda, which he established and still leads, he manages a broader portfolio of finance, healthcare and service businesses.
